feed_summary: PHP has warned of another way an attacker could run code on a web server, two days after it shipped emergency fixes for the critical PHP2Shell flaws. The new issue, assigned CVE-2026-115560, affects only web applications configured in an unusual way, and PHP considers it an unlikely risk. The project is not issuing an emergency fix for it. title: URGENT - PHP Warns of Another Unpatched RCE Two Days After Emergency PHP2Shell Patches
